description: User-invoked as /doc-registry. Builds a registry of every *.md file under docs/ and .claude/, then reports any cross-references that point at missing files, with rename candidates ranked by confidence. Use for a one-shot corpus health check before or after structural documentation changes (adding milestones, reorganising folders, bulk renames). For automated iteration and auto-fix, use /loop update-docs instead.
